verdict.rationale: Grok Bot ships an official desktop app: Linux .deb/.rpm/AppImage packages, macOS/Windows/Linux apps per the runtime probe, and desktop chat. It can also run commands on the local desktop with per-command approval. But nothing shows global OS-level shortcuts or the Bot seeing what is on the user's own screen; the Agent Computer view shows the Bot's cloud desktop, not yours. Missing for 10: OS-level/global keyboard shortcuts, access to the user's on-screen content, independent hands-on corroboration of the desktop app.
